utv.uk.title: Grantchester
utv.uk.description: Crime drama. Will wants to grab a quiet moment with Geordie to tell him that he and Bonnie have decided to leave Grantchester, but any chance he might have had is thrown out the window when Geordie receives a call about a dead body at the River View Hotel - as the time for Sunday service approaches, Will and Bonnie enter the church but are stopped short on discovery of an abandoned baby inside. Upon inspecting the blanket the baby is wrapped in, Will and Bonnie see that it is marked River View Hotel and learn that a young woman had checked in there the night before and made a phone call to the halfway house - after Ernie reports that he witnessed a young girl wearing a school blazer enter the church that morning, Will and Geordie probe into the staff and pupils of the Fidelis School for Girls and secrets start to emerge that turn the entire investigation on its head. When Will later finds an inopportune moment to tell Geordie that he is leaving, his friend is stung by the news.. (Crime, Drama, Mystery) - 2014

utv.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
utv.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. There is also a farewell as bull Ezra's time on the farm comes to an end. Kelvin takes him to market in the hope of finding him a new home, marking another change among the farm's animals. Then it is all hands on deck for the Royal Cheshire Show. Liz and Kelvin pack enough farm produce to fill a huge marquee, along with the butcher's fridge to keep their Milo sausages chilled. With everything ready, they step into the world of trading and face a busy day behind the counter. (Reality) - 2023

utv.uk.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure - Orkney
utv.uk.description: James' adventure begins on the Orkney Islands, a place he's never been to and is excited to explore - he's also joined by top Scottish chef and good friend Nick Nairn for the journey. James gets straight to it and shops for hand-dived scallops before setting up his mobile kitchen in Stromness Harbour to make BBQ scallops with black pudding, apple and hazelnut butter - he then takes to the skies to visit North Ronaldsay, where the people are outnumbered by sheep, and cooks up some lamb chops. eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - The Last Frontier
eden.uk.plus1.description: Revealing the extraordinary riches and wonders of the polar regions that have kept people visiting them for thousands of years. Today, their survival relies on a combination of ancient wisdom and cutting-edge science. Most Arctic people live in Siberia, either in cities like Norilsk - the coldest city on earth - or out on the tundra, where tribes like the Dogan survive by herding reindeer. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Summer
eden.uk.plus1.description: It is high summer in the polar regions, and the sun never sets. Vast hordes of summer visitors cram a lifetime of drama into one long, magical day; they must feed, fight and rear their young in this brief window of plenty. Summer is a tough time for the polar bear family, as their ice world melts away and the cubs take their first swimming lesson. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Autumn
eden.uk.plus1.description: Polar landscapes in autumn are transformed as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some now battle to breed, and for the hardy few it's a time of opportunity. In the Arctic, polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast to wait for the return of the ice. Tempers soon fray and violent contests break out. Off the coast 2,000 beluga whales head for a special estuary, a gigantic `whale spa'. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Winter
eden.uk.plus1.description: Winter is the greatest test for life in the polar regions, as temperatures plummet to 70 below and winds reach 200kph. Only a few remarkable survivors gamble on remaining in these extreme conditions. In the Arctic, a female polar bear treks into the mountains to give birth. Out on the frozen ocean, the entire population of the world's spectacled eider ducks braves the winter in a giant ice hole. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Manhattan Island
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael begins his American adventure on Manhattan Island. Starting at New York's Grand Central Terminal, he boards the Manhattan subway system, the busiest rail transit system in the US. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Brooklyn to Montauk
eden.uk.plus1.description: Beginning in Brooklyn, Michael hears the moving story behind the construction of the world's first steel suspension bridge high above the East River. Below ground, he investigates the arrival of New York City's first subway and the dangers faced by the men who built it: the `sandhogs'. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - New York City to Albany
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael follows America's iconic River Hudson north through New York State. Beginning at New York City's Penn Station, Michael rides the national rail carrier service, Amtrak. He hears from Amtrak's police chief how railroad policing began to tackle the nation's most notorious train robbers, among them Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Schenectady to Niagara Falls
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo braves the awesome power and drenching spray of Niagara Falls in the `Maid of the Mist' to share what artists, daredevils and millions of tourists have billed as one of the most spectacular experiences on the planet. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Abandoned Engineering - The Valkyrie Assassin
eden.uk.plus1.description: The underground base with the power to destroy a nation, the site linked with an attempt to kill a dictator, and an ancient world discovered in the American wilderness. (Documentary, News, Technology) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - North West & Isle of Man Part 4

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - North West & Isle of Man Part 5
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo continues his journey along the Cumbrian coast visiting Whitehaven, which from 1630 became the third most popular port in England. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Whitby to Robin Hood's Bay
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo continues his railway adventure at Whitby, where he explores the port's shipbuilding and seafaring heritage. In Grosmont, Michael boards the first steam locomotive built in Britain since the 1960s. In the vast open landscape of the North York Moors, Michael discovers one of the most powerful military radars in the world - where tension rises as the team suspect a missile launch. (Documentary, Travel) - 2023

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Scarborough to Bridlington

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - South Coast Part 4

itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E1 Orkney James goes on a culinary road trip around the UK and kicks off his travels in the Orkneys, where he is joined by fellow chef Nick Nairn. He shops for hand-dived scallops, before setting up his mobile kitchen in Stromness harbour to make barbecue scallops with black pudding, apple and hazelnut butter. He also meets the owner of a unique herd of sheep in the remote island of North Ronaldsay.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E35 James is joined by actress Shelley Conn, who is starring in ITV1's Adultery. The comedian and travel writer Dom Joly is also in the house, with chefs Sally Abe and Glynn Purnell. James cooks Thai green curry and Spanish tapas.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh

Plus, the second instalment of the Wildlife Sanctuary in the making, Urban Birder David Lindo gets up close with pelicans, and Ian Burrell has a good measure of rum hot toddies.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itv1anglia.uk.description: S5 E7 The Fletchers are back at the Royal Cheshire Show, but this year they're swapping the show ring for trading. For Marnie and her lamb, Hope, it's an emotional journey towards their debut in the Young Handlers class. First-time nerves are running high, but preparations take a worrying turn when Kelvin spots maggots in Hope's fleece.

They have to deliver delicious dishes using a recipe they have not had any training for, with the two stars who impress the most securing their places in the quarter-finals, while the others face the dreaded cook-off.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas

Once back in his beachside kitchen, Ainsley proceeds to cook a whole snapper.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : Scotland v Australia
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E30 Scotland v Australia (Kick-off 3.10pm). Jill Douglas presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. Scotland have an excellent recent record against the Wallabies, winning four of the last five meetings between the sides. The most recent encounter saw them prevail 27-13 here two years ago, with four different players scoring tries for the victors. With commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie, analysis from John Barclay, Greig Laidlaw, and George Gregan, and reports by Lee McKenzie.

They also revisit some of the most memorable moments in the programme's history, drawing on a quarter of a century of terrifying trials and camp chaos to arm the next bunch of unsuspecting celebrities with an arsenal of must-have jungle hacks.

itv1anglia.uk.title: UEFA Nations League Live : Spain v England
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E6 Spain v England (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match in Group A3, held at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. The teams last met in the opening round of fixtures in September, when world champions Spain fought back from 2-1 down to claim a 3-2 win at Wembley Stadium. It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Gabriel Clarke.

cinemax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
cinemax.us.description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Hail Satan?
cinemax.us.description: Lucien Greaves co-founds the Satanic Temple, a religious movement that calls for a revolution to save the nation's soul. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: The Apparition
cinemax.us.description: A paranormal researcher (Tom Felton) must save a couple (Ashley Greene, Sebastian Stan) from a malevolent entity that feeds on fear and torments them no matter where they run. - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemax.us.description: Two divorce mediators spend a wild weekend partying with a politician and his eccentric family. - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemax.us.description: Former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption in Canada. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties and a smuggling ring. - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemax.us.description: A filmmaking crew (Heather Donahue, Michael C. Williams, Joshua Leonard) hikes into Maryland's Black Hills Forest seeking clues about a legendary witch. - 1999

cinemax.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemax.us.description: A group of friends (James Allen McCune, Callie Hernandez, Corbin Reid) and their two guides encounter the legendary Blair Witch while exploring the Black Hills Forest in Maryland. - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: When a townie takes collegians on an overnight tour in Burkittsville, Md., they awake to chaos and have no memory of sleeping. - 2000

cinemax.us.title: The Judge
cinemax.us.description: A slick Chicago lawyer (Robert Downey Jr.) returns home to Indiana upon the passing of his mother, then soon becomes engaged in defending his estranged father (Robert Duvall), a recovering alcoholic who will be tried for a hit-and-run death. - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemax.us.description: A Marine (Matthew Modine) and his companions (Adam Baldwin, Vincent D'Onofrio) endure basic training under a sadistic drill sergeant and fight in the 1968 Tet offensive. - 1987

cinemax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemax.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The East
cinemax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemax.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (War, Biography, Drama) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemaxaction.us.title: Due Date
cinemaxaction.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Dark comedy, Drama, Movie) - 2010-11-05

cinemaxaction.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxaction.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Biography, Comedy, Comedy drama, Docudrama, Drama) - 2023-09-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxaction.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Crime, Drama, Movie) - 2011-12-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Darkest Minds
cinemaxaction.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2018-08-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
cinemaxaction.us.description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (Action, Adventure, Movie) - 2024-05-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Arctic
cinemaxaction.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 2018-05-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemaxaction.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Crime drama, Movie, Romance, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2011-03-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1974-03-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah
cinemaxaction.us.description: Time-travelers' efforts to prevent a dinosaur's mutation result in the creation of a three-headed dragon that terrorizes Japan. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1991-12-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra. (Action, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1964-04-29

cinemaxaction.us.title: DC League of Super-Pets
cinemaxaction.us.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children) - 2022-07-29

cinemaxaction.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Daytrippers

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Collision Course

During the time spent together, the two men come to understand and respect each other. (Drama, Movie) - 1985-06-29

(Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical drama, History) - 2010-05-13

(Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2024-05-08

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Flash
cinemaxhits.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2023-06-14

cinemaxhits.us.title: Mickey 17

cinemaxhits.us.title: Contagion
cinemaxhits.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Drama, Movie, Science Fiction, Thriller) - 2011-09-09

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Daytrippers
cinemaxhits.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy, Drama, Movie) - 1996-03-11

cinemaxhits.us.title: Adult Best Friends
cinemaxhits.us.description: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (Comedy, Movie) - 2024-06-08

cinemaxhits.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
cinemaxhits.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2002-04-19

cinemaxhits.us.title: They All Laughed
cinemaxhits.us.description: The employees of New York City's Odyssey Detective Agency can't seem to prevent themselves from getting over-involved in their clients' lives. When aging gumshoe John Russo (Ben Gazzara) is assigned to trail an Italian millionaire's wife, Angela (Audrey Hepburn), he inevitably falls for her continental charm. His partner, Charles (John Ritter), is similarly unable to keep his hands off the woman he's trailing -- a winsome cheating spouse named Dolores (Dorothy Stratten). (Comedy, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 1981

cinemaxhits.us.title: Shazam!
cinemaxhits.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Movie) - 2019-04-03

cinemaxhits.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
cinemaxhits.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Movie) - 2023-03-15

cinemaxwest.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes

After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. cinemaxwest.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

cinemaxwest.us.title: Black Butterfly

After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: The East

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
comedydynamics.us.description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

comedydynamics.us.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
comedydynamics.us.description: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

comedydynamics.us.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Aloha Fluffy
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic discusses his crazy world of family, friends, and world travels.

comedydynamics.us.title: Anjelah Johnson: Mahalo & Goodnight
comedydynamics.us.description: Filmed at the Hawaii Theater in Honolulu, Hawaii, Anjelah Johnson's fourth stand-up comedy special dishes on awkward massages, home invasions, spiders and being a full-grown child.

comedydynamics.us.title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
comedydynamics.us.description: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

comedydynamics.us.title: Gina Brillon: The Floor Is Lava
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic pulls no punches when discussing her childhood, culture and the transition from single to married life with her Midwestern husband.

comedydynamics.us.title: Sinbad: Make Me Wanna Holla
comedydynamics.us.description: Comic Sinbad discusses the life advice his family gave him; why he's tired of people with no talent having clothing lines; who he really is.

comedydynamics.us.title: Sara Huntington: Rust Belt Royalty
comedydynamics.us.description: Sara Huntington shows off the stand-up skills behind her TikTok and Instagram accounts in her debut special from Columbus, Ohio.

comedydynamics.us.title: Aries Spears: Comedy Blueprint
comedydynamics.us.description: Armed with his ferociously aggressive style of comedy, MAD TV alum Aries Spears takes the stage in Philadelphia for 'Comedy Blueprint.' No one - not black, not white, not gay, not straight - is safe from his jokes and impressions.

comedydynamics.us.title: Henry Rollins: Keep Talking, Pal.
comedydynamics.us.description: Henry Rollins waxes at a high rate of speed about the brilliance of RuPaul, meeting David Bowie, his weirdest shows, why women should rule, and more in a live performance from Portland, Ore.

comedydynamics.us.title: Tahir Moore: Aging Out
comedydynamics.us.description: Tahir Moore brings high-energy, no-filter comedy in a wild ride through the zombie apocalypse, fancy toilets, naps, and aging; self-roasting, brutally honest, and always hilarious-this is stand-up with zero chill, big laughs, and all heart.

comedydynamics.us.title: Steven Chen: Pretty Good
comedydynamics.us.description: Steven Chen performs a standup comedy act at his home club in Washington, D.C.; he talks about buying paper towels and vacuums and researching on the internet.

comedydynamics.us.title: Paul Rodriguez: The Here and Wow
comedydynamics.us.description: Veteran comedian, Paul Rodriguez hits the stage to give his perspectives on life, from being peer pressured into believing in God to claiming to be the village idiot.

comedydynamics.us.title: Nicole Blaine: Life's a Bit
comedydynamics.us.description: Nicole Blaine bribes her husband and children to play the parts that inspire her jokes.

comedydynamics.us.title: Morgan Murphy: Irish Goodbye
comedydynamics.us.description: Morgan Murphy performs her comedy routine.

comedydynamics.us.title: Marc Maron: Thinky Pain
comedydynamics.us.description: Marc Maron discusses everything from pornography to religion.

comedydynamics.us.title: Louie Anderson: Big Underwear
comedydynamics.us.description: Iconic comedian Louie Anderson delivers to his fans his unique brand of humor and warmth from the historic Palace Theatre in Los Angeles.

comedydynamics.us.title: Louie Anderson: Big Baby Boomer
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic discusses topics such as bad habits, pesky family members, and his aging body.

comedydynamics.us.title: Josh Blue: Sticky Change
comedydynamics.us.description: The "Last Comic Standing"-winning comic performs.

comedydynamics.us.title: Josh Blue: Delete
comedydynamics.us.description: In his hometown of Denver, Josh Blue discusses the daily details of his life.

comedydynamics.us.title: Lavell Crawford: I Could Eat - Part 1
comedydynamics.us.description: Lavell Crawford is back and here to contemplate how "My 600 Pound Life" could go for 15 seasons and he was still underweight, the kind of racist you have to be to not take a free holiday, and explosive consequences in a Taco Bell bathroom.

(Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality) - 2020-11-23

foodnetwork.us.title: Holiday Wars - Thanksgiving Turkey Trot
foodnetwork.us.description: In the final qualifier, Jeff Mauro tasks three new teams with crafting a turkey and rider to race in the first annual Turkey Trot; Judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide whose Thanksgiving creations will move on and whose will not. (Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality) - 2022-11-13

foodnetwork.us.title: Holiday Wars - Reindeer's New Hobby
foodnetwork.us.description: The six remaining teams face off as Jeff challenges them to envision a hobby for Santa's reindeer to enjoy when they aren't pulling the sleigh; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira judge the designs before flying one team home.

foodnetwork.us.title: Holiday Wars - Ugly Sweater Party
foodnetwork.us.description: Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a woodland creature that is throwing an ugly sweater party for all its forest friends; at the end of the festive fiesta, judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira eliminate one more team.

foodnetwork.us.title: Holiday Wars - Time Travelin' Santa
foodnetwork.us.description: Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.

foodnetwork.us.title: Holiday Wars - A Very Peanuts Christmas Tree
foodnetwork.us.description: Jeff Mauro invites the remaining teams to create a Christmas tree featuring Charles Schulz's beloved Peanuts characters; two teams will face off in the finale for a trip to Iceland.

foodnetwork.us.title: Holiday Wars - North Pole Talent Show
foodnetwork.us.description: Santa throws a North Pole talent show and the final two teams showcase the secret talents of the town's brave residents; Jeff Mauro, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira crown the champion.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Aging Brain
foodnetwork.us.description: Learn what's behind mental decline with age, and how to improve memory, focus and concentration with NeuroQ's Darrin Peterson and Dale Bredesen MD.

foodnetwork.us.title: Bathroom Makeover
foodnetwork.us.description: Transform your bath affordably in just one day!

foodnetwork.us.title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini - Seafood Feast
foodnetwork.us.description: Gabe makes a seafood feast with roasted branzino and seafood stew.

foodnetwork.us.title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini - Italian Classics
foodnetwork.us.description: Gabe makes classic dishes like Risotto ai Funghi and Spaghetti Carbonara.

foodnetwork.us.title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini - Dinner for Two
foodnetwork.us.description: Chef Gabe Bertaccini makes gnocchi di ricotta alla sorrentina and lasagna bianca; the pillowy ricotta gnocchi are baked in a bright tomato sauce with melted mozzarella and this lasagna goes all-in on creamy béchamel, layers of pasta and melty cheese.

foodnetwork.us.title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini - Primo to Secondo
foodnetwork.us.description: Chef Gabe Bertaccini takes our taste buds to central Italy, beginning with Crespelle alla Fiorentina, delicate Italian crêpes filled with creamy ricotta and spinach. Then, Lamb Chops Scottadito is made complete with a side of Herb Cast-Iron Potatoes.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - One-Stop Thanksgiving
foodnetwork.us.description: Pumpkin gingersnap cheesecake with salted caramel sauce; broccoli wild rice casserole; no-knead clover leaf rolls; green beans and tomatoes; soul sweet taters; pumpkin smoothies; leftover Thanksgiving panini.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - Thanksgiving Potluck: Kitchen Confessional
foodnetwork.us.description: Ree Drummond makes a ranch-style holiday meal: pumpkin rum cake with maple whipped cream, glazed ham, broccoli rice casserole, slow cooker sweet potatoes.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - Fast Thanksgiving Favorites
foodnetwork.us.description: Ree Drummond shortcuts Thanksgiving with fast favorites for the big day feast; she cuts the cooking time with a spatchcock turkey; she bakes stuffing muffins, brown butter and sage pull apart bread, and fruity cream cheese puff pastries for dessert.

foodnetwork.us.title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy - Best Sellers
foodnetwork.us.description: Danielle Sepsy shares two items from her bakery, The Hungry Gnome; she makes cherry vanilla bean scones, then bakes blueberry crumb muffins topped with a buttery streusel.

foodnetwork.us.title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy - Long Island Favorites
foodnetwork.us.description: Danielle Sepsy teams up with her mom to make Pepperoni Stromboli with a flavorful filling and golden crust. Then, Danielle welcomes her grandma to the kitchen to make a Mile High Classic Top-Heavy Deli Crumb Cake with a thick layer of buttery crumbs.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Kitchen - Turkey Day To-Do List
foodnetwork.us.description: Whole roasted turkey with sumac, lemon and thyme, plus gravy; charred orange cranberry relish; spinach and artichoke stuffed sweet potatoes; cornbread dressing with sausage and mushrooms; pumpkin spice latte pie; decor ideas and wine tips.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Kitchen - Retro Cocktail Party
foodnetwork.us.description: Throwing it back to iconic party bites that deserve a comeback with new twists; fon-duo of taleggio fondue and quick horchata fondue, mini beef wellington bites, and retro rum ginger pomegranate punch.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Kitchen - Turkey Day Road Trip
foodnetwork.us.description: The co-hosts celebrate regional Thanksgiving traditions, as Sunny Anderson goes big with Texas two-step turkey, Geoffrey Zakarian uses New England produce for a vegetable clafoutis and Jeff Mauro bakes Midwestern butterscotch apple gooey butter cake.

foodnetwork.us.title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown - Casserole with the Punches
foodnetwork.us.description: Scott Conant welcomes three of Bobby Flay's besties to attempt a Turkey Day classic -- the casserole; chefs Anne Burrell, Tiffani Faison and Jet Tila bring their best dishes to the table.

foodnetwork.us.title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown - Stuff It, Bobby!
foodnetwork.us.description: Eddie Jackson brings Thanksgiving game day vibes to Bobby Flay's kitchen, and chefs Maneet Chauhan, Christian Petroni and Michael Psilakis tackle dishes that are stuffed.

foodnetwork.us.title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown - Holiday Leftover Revival
foodnetwork.us.description: It's a "Chopped" takeover as Tiffani Faison welcomes her fellow judges to transform mystery leftovers into Thanksgiving masterpieces; chefs Marc Murphy, Amanda Freitag and Scott Conant battle to see if they can knock the stuffing out of Bobby Flay.

foodnetwork.us.title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown - Pie in the Sky
foodnetwork.us.description: Ina Garten passes the whipped cream as she recruits chefs Amanda Freitag, Aarti Sequeira and Duff Goldman to serve Bobby Flay a slice of humble pie; in each round, these chefs bake up an ode to everyone's favorite Thanksgiving dessert.

foodnetwork.us.title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas - The Holly Jolly Holiday Tournament Returns
foodnetwork.us.description: Fieri is back to host a holiday showdown in a Winner's Wonderland! All-new teams of 32 superstar chefs create sweet and savory delights in hopes of sleighing the competition, winning the title, scoring $100,000 and delivering big bucks for charity.

foodnetwork.us.title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas - 'Tis the Season...for Culinary Battles ᴺᵉʷ

mgmplus.us.description: King Henry VIII has died, and his only heir, a young Edward VI (Warren Saire), is dying too. Minister John Dudley (John Wood) doesn't want the Roman Catholic Princess Mary (Jane Lapotaire) to become queen, as that would end the Protestant Reformation. Dudley plots to keep Edward alive long enough to name Lady Jane Grey (Helena Bonham Carter) as his heir and also marries Jane to his son, Guilford (Cary Elwes). Jane and Guilford soon fall in love, but the kingdom doesn't believe they should rule. (Historical drama) - 1986

Despite the protests of Oliver's father, the young couple marry. Oliver finds a job at a legal firm in New York City, but their happy life comes crashing down when it's discovered that Jenny has a terminal illness. Together, they try to cope with the situation as best they can. (Romance, Drama) - 1970

mgmplus.us.title: Acrimony

Once they fell in love, Melinda molded herself into everything he wanted her to be. She sacrificed for him, worked to support his grandiose dreams, and put up with him for better or for worse. Then, one day she realized that after all she had done, another woman was reaping the lavish rewards. That's when Melinda lost it, and now she cannot let it go. (Thriller, Drama, Horror, Romance) - 2018

mgmplus.us.title: Flashdance

When Alex discovers that her handsome boss, Nick Hurley (Michael Nouri), is both interested in her and supportive of her performing career, she renews her efforts to get accepted into a prestigious dance conservatory. Although Alex is frightened of failure, she is cheered on by Nick, as well as by her mentor, former ballet performer Hanna Long (Lilia Skala). (Drama, Romance, Music) - 1983

Intent on seeing justice served, Paul goes after the kingpin who ultimately supplied the crack. As he hunts down the kingpin's minions, Paul starts taking out a large part of the city's drug-dealing population on a violent killing spree. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1987

mgmplushits.us.title: The Bridge at Remagen

Meanwhile, Maj. Paul Kreuger (Robert Vaughn) of the German armed forces is ordered to defend the town and the nearby bridge across the Rhine. As a desperate battle commences, Hartman and Kreuger both find themselves pawns of larger forces and witness how war can turn each side against itself. (War, Historical drama) - 1969

mgmplushits.us.title: Ironweed
mgmplushits.us.description: In Depression-era Albany, N.Y., erstwhile baseball star Francis Phelan has become an alcoholic vagabond after guilt over accidentally killing his infant son led him to desert his family. Over the course of several days, he ambles from gritty job to dirty bar to makeshift sleeping quarters. By chance, he encounters fellow itinerant drinker and his sometime lover, Helen Archer. Together, they wax nostalgic about their haunted pasts. (Drama) - 1987

mgmplushits.us.title: Henry V
mgmplushits.us.description: In this gritty screen adaptation of Shakespeare's play about the heroic and ruthless king, Henry V of England (Kenneth Branagh) determines to lay claim to the kingdom of France. Henry's self-doubt and the diminished morale of his army stand in the way of a victory that would unite the two countries and provide Henry with a queen (Emma Thompson). However, his sheer determination and his impassioned speeches ready his men for the bloodiest of battles -- Agincourt. (Historical drama) - 1989

mgmplushits.us.title: Blow Out

Jack jumps into the water and fishes out Sally (Nancy Allen) from the car, but the other passenger is already dead -- a governor intending to run for president. As Jack does some investigating of his tapes, and starts a perilous romance with Sally, he enters a tangled web of conspiracy that might leave him dead. (Thriller, Mystery) - 1981

movies.us.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
movies.us.description: An outrageous British woman (Renée Zellweger) decides to take control of her life, but instead falls for two very different men (Colin Firth, Hugh Grant). - 2001

movies.us.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
movies.us.description: An attractive lawyer and Bridget's (Renée Zellweger) former boss (Hugh Grant) threaten her newfound happiness with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth). - 2004

movies.us.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
movies.us.description: Befuddled mom-to-be Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) must figure out which of the two men (Colin Firth, Patrick Dempsey) in her life is the father of her child. - 2016

movies.us.title: No Strings Attached
movies.us.description: After sex enters the equation, two lifelong friends (Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher) make a pact to keep their relationship purely physical. - 2011

movies.us.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
movies.us.description: A columnist (Kate Hudson) tries to make a man (Matthew McConaughey) dump her, but he bets his boss that she will fall in love. - 2003

movies.us.title: Failure to Launch
movies.us.description: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest. - 2006

movies.us.title: 80 for Brady
movies.us.description: Four best friends live life to the fullest when they embark on a wild trip to see their hero, Tom Brady, play in the 2017 Super Bowl. - 2023

movies.us.title: Three Months
movies.us.description: On the eve of his high school graduation, Caleb learns he's been exposed to HIV. While he waits three months for his results, he finds love in the most unlikely of places. - 2022

movies.us.title: The Lost City
movies.us.description: Reclusive author Loretta Sage goes on tour to promote her new adventure novel with handsome cover model Alan. When Loretta gets kidnapped by an eccentric billionaire who's looking for a lost treasure, Alan tries to become a real hero and rescue her. - 2022

movies.us.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
movies.us.description: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers embark on an epic quest to retrieve a lost relic, but things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people. - 2023

movies.us.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
movies.us.description: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers embark on an epic quest to retrieve a lost relic, but things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people. (Fantasy, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2023

movies.us.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
movies.us.description: Spawned from a lab experiment gone awry, teenage terrapins Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael live in the sewers beneath New York. Although their rodent sensei, Splinter, advises against showing themselves above ground, the justice-loving, pizza-eating brothers can't stand idly by while evil Shredder and his minions terrorize the city. With help from intrepid reporter April O'Neil (Megan Fox) and her cameraman (Will Arnett), the Turtles set out to save New York. (Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2014

movies.us.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
movies.us.description: The turtles face a new challenge when Shredder escapes from custody and joins forces with Baxter Stockman, a mad scientist who plans to use a serum to take over the world. Along for the ride are Bebop and Rocksteady, two dimwitted henchmen who provide plenty of muscle. Luckily, the turtles have their own allies in April O'Neil, Vernon Fenwick and Casey Jones, a hockey-masked vigilante. As the pizza-loving heroes prepare for battle, the notorious Krang also emerges to pose an even greater threat. (Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2016

movies.us.title: Transformers
movies.us.description: An ancient struggle between two Cybertronian races, the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons, comes to Earth, with a clue to the ultimate power held by a teenager. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2007

movies.us.title: Transformers
movies.us.description: An ancient struggle between two Cybertronian races, the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons, comes to Earth, with a clue to the ultimate power held by a teenager. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2007

movies.us.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
movies.us.description: Two years after he and his Autobot friends saved the Earth from the Decepticons, Sam Witwicky faces a new battle: college. Meanwhile, Optimus Prime and the Autobots are working with a secret military organization and trying to make a home for themselves on Earth. When an ancient Decepticon known as The Fallen rises up to wreak vengeance, Sam and his girlfriend, Mikaela, must figure out the history of the Transformers on Earth and find a way to defeat The Fallen once and for all. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2009

movies.us.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
movies.us.description: Sam Witwicky and his new girlfriend, Carly, join the fray when the evil Decepticons renew their longstanding war against the Autobots. Optimus Prime believes that resurrecting ancient Transformer Sentinel Prime, once the leader of the Autobots, may lead to victory. That decision, however, has devastating consequences. The war appears to tip in favor of the Decepticons, leading to a climactic battle in Chicago. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2011

movies.us.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
movies.us.description: After an epic battle, a great city lies in ruins, but the Earth itself is saved. As humanity begins to pick up the pieces, a shadowy group emerges to try to take control of history. Meanwhile, an ancient and powerful new menace sets its sights on Earth. A new group of humans, led by Cade Yeager (Mark Wahlberg), helps Optimus Prime (Peter Cullen) and the Autobots rise up to meet their most fearsome challenge yet: a worldwide war of good versus evil. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2014

movies.us.title: Bumblebee
movies.us.description: On the run in the year 1987, Bumblebee the Autobot seeks refuge in a junkyard in a small California beach town. Charlie, on the brink of turning 18 years old and trying to find her place in the world, soon discovers the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee. When Charlie revives him, she quickly learns that this is no ordinary yellow Volkswagen. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2018

movies.us.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
movies.us.description: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with a powerful faction of Transformers known as the Maximals to save Earth. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Fantasy) - 2023

screenpixaction.us.description: Stationed in Ashiya, Japan, U.S. Air Force Rescue Service members Master Sgt. Mike Takashima (Yul Brynner), Lt. Col. Glenn Stevenson (Richard Widmark) and Lt. John Gregg (George Chakiris) all carry personal demons stemming from a past event. When the orders come down to rescue stranded Japanese survivors of a shipwreck caused by a storm, the three men jump into action. On their way through the still violent storm, each shares the tale from his past that has affected him to this day. (Adventure, Drama) - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: Legend of the Lost
screenpixaction.us.description: Brit Paul Bonnard (Rossano Brazzi) enlists gruff American Joe January (John Wayne) to help him find a hidden treasure that is worth a fortune. Before long, they are joined by prostitute Dita (Sophia Loren), who is moved by Bonnard's earnestness, and the three embark on a journey through the wild in hopes of finding an ancient lost city. They finally stumble upon the riches, but, after Bonnard feuds with Dita, he angrily takes the jewels and supplies, and leaves his partners to die in the desert. (Adventure) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Call of the Jungle
screenpixaction.us.description: Trouble comes to a tropical island paradise when sacred pearls are stolen from a tribal temple. Local amateur sleuth Tana (Ann Corio) decides to investigate the matter to find out who's responsible, but following leads only earns her a place on the authorities' list of suspects. Meanwhile, a police officer, Jim (James Bush), is injured while working on the case, and Tana, nursing him back to health, attempts to get him to team up with her to track down the real crooks. (Adventure) - 1944

screenpixaction.us.title: The Emerald Forest
screenpixaction.us.description: American Bill Markham (Powers Boothe) has taken his family to the jungles of Brazil, where he has been hired to design a dam. Unexpectedly, a native tribe abducts his son, Tommy (Charley Boorman). Bill spends an entire decade looking for Tommy, only to discover that the boy has adopted the ways of the indigenous people he's been living with. Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe. (Adventure) - 1985

screenpixaction.us.title: Solomon and Sheba
screenpixaction.us.description: Near death, King David has a vision that his poet son, Solomon (Yul Brynner), should succeed him, rather than hot-headed Adonijah (George Sanders). Furious, Adonijah departs the court, swearing he will become king. Other rulers are concerned that Solomon's benevolent rule and interest in monotheism will threaten their tyrannical, polytheistic kingdoms. The Queen of Sheba (Gina Lollobrigida) makes an agreement with the Egyptian pharaoh (David Farrar) to corrupt Solomon for their mutual benefit. (Historical drama) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: The Satan Bug
screenpixaction.us.description: Special Agent Lee Barrett (George Maharis) joins forces with Ann Williams (Anne Francis), a general's daughter, to recover a biological weapon stolen from a secret government lab. Learning that the pathogen could destroy all life on Earth, they focus their attention on a mysterious millionaire who may have orchestrated the theft. After annihilating a small town in Florida, the villain turns his attention to Los Angeles -- and the duo must race to stop the city's destruction. (Science fiction) - 1965

screenpixaction.us.title: Call of the Wild
screenpixaction.us.description: Based on Jack London's classic about two gold-seekers who forge their way to the Klondike with their faithful dog Buck. (Adventure) - 1976

screenpixaction.us.title: True Heart
screenpixaction.us.description: Twin brother and sister Sam and Bonnie, who argue frequently, become stranded after surviving a horrific plane crash in the Canadian wilderness. While struggling through the forest, they meet a wily Native North American named Khonanesta, who agrees to help them reunite with their family. As the trio traverses the treacherous wood, they strive to elude poachers who wish to hunt Khonanesta's adored Kodiak bear companion. (Children, Adventure) - 1997

screenpixvoices.us.title: The First Power
screenpixvoices.us.description: A Los Angeles policeman (Lou Diamond Phillips) hunts a killer (Jeff Kober) brought back from the gas chamber by Satan. (Horror) - 1990

screenpixvoices.us.title: Number One With a Bullet
screenpixvoices.us.description: A suave Los Angeles detective (Billy Dee Williams) and his quirky partner (Robert Carradine) hunt a drug lord who has social clout. - 1987

screenpixvoices.us.description: A hooker (Pam Grier) and a radical (Margaret Markov) escape from a brutal Philippine prison, chained together. - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.description: Two men (Robert Urich, Carl Weathers) of different races, who loathe each other, escape from a chain gang shackled together. - 1986

screenpixvoices.us.description: Two Los Angeles private eyes (Bill Cosby, Robert Culp) find a missing woman and follow her to loot from a Pittsburgh bank. - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.description: Racial tension flares up among an ex-cop, a bigot and a black entertainer who band together to rob a bank. - 1959

screenpixvoices.us.description: An outstanding jazz score highlights this tale of two American musicians in Paris whose lives are changed by tourists. - 1961

screenpixvoices.us.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
screenpixvoices.us.description: A detective's (Sidney Poitier) friend, an activist clergyman (Martin Landau), is suspected of killing a San Francisco prostitute. - 1970

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Organization
screenpixvoices.us.description: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
screenpixvoices.us.description: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Thriller) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Pressure Point
screenpixvoices.us.description: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment. (Drama) - 1962

screenpixvoices.us.title: Paris Blues
screenpixvoices.us.description: Despite being far from home, American jazz musicians Ram Bowen (Paul Newman) and Eddie Cook (Sidney Poitier) are content living and working in Paris. Ram knows it's the best place for him to develop his musical reputation, and Eddie is far away from the racism that once greeted him on a regular basis. But after meeting and falling in love with American tourists Lillian (Joanne Woodward) and Connie (Diahann Carroll), the pair must decide whether their artistic integrity is worth abandoning. (Romance) - 1961

screenpixvoices.us.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
screenpixvoices.us.description: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children. (Crime drama) - 1970

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gun Belt
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After giving up his gunfighting ways, Billy Ringo (George Montgomery) has settled down with his new wife, Arlene (Helen Westcott), on a ranch he's just purchased with his brother, Matt (John Dehner), and nephew Chip (Tab Hunter). But when Matt tricks him into participating in a bank robbery -- and frames him as the ringleader -- Billy is forced to go on the run from lawman Wyatt Earp (James Millican), and once again take up his guns against his former rival, Ike Clinton (William Bishop). (Western) - 1953

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gun Duel in Durango
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bank robber Will Sabre is looking to leave his life of crime behind in favor of marrying his sweetheart, Judy. But Sabre's gang, led by Dunsten, has no intention of letting go of such a skilled shootist. When he rejects the demand to rejoin their ranks, these cruel crooks promptly use their next heist to frame the innocent Sabre. To save his reputation and future, he must set out to capture his former cohorts -- with the law in hot pursuit. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: High Noon, Part II: The Return of Will Kane
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A retired sheriff (Lee Majors) has a showdown with the bad bounty hunter (Pernell Roberts) who replaced him. - 1980

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Billy Two Hats
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A bearded Scot (Gregory Peck) robs a bank with a young Indian (Desi Arnaz Jr.), then leaves him with an old rancher's young wife. - 1974

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Red River
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A Texas cattle baron (James Arness), his foster son (Bruce Boxleitner), a gunfighter (Gregory Harrison) and a former slave drive a herd up the Chisholm Trail. - 1988

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Doc
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Doc Holliday (Stacy Keach), Kate Elder (Faye Dunaway) and Wyatt Earp (Harris Yulin) hang out in Tombstone before the shootout at the OK corral. - 1971

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Cattle Annie and Little Britches
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Two teenage girls rally what's left of the Doolin-Dalton outlaw gang after Doolin is caught. - 1980

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Return of a Man Called Horse
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An English lord (Richard Harris) returns to America and finds his Dakota brothers enslaved by a trapper (Geoffrey Lewis). - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Young Billy Young
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An old marshal (Robert Mitchum) finally faces his son's killer, joined by an outlaw (Robert Walker) who becomes his deputy. - 1969

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Hills Run Red
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An ex-con sets out to kill his former partner, a soldier who escaped capture and made off with their stolen loot. - 1966

screenpixwesterns.us.description: A scout (Dana Andrews) stops troublemakers, rescues a Mexican beauty (Linda Cristal) and talks peace with a Comanche chief (Kent Smith). - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Geronimo
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The Apache chief (Chuck Connors) escapes to Mexico with his mate (Kamala Devi), his warriors and his right-hand man (Ross Martin). - 1962

screenpixwesterns.us.title: War Paint
screenpixwesterns.us.description: With only nine days to deliver a peace treaty to the chief of a strong Native American tribe, Lt. Billings (Robert Stack) and his troopers are in a race against time to avoid all-out war. Since time is of the essence, Billings recruits the chief's son, Taslik (Keith Larsen), to guide the men to the village. However, Billings and his men are unaware that a group of renegades, wary of the suspicious U.S. treaty, seek to kill the messengers before they can complete their mission. (Western) - 1953

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Davy Crockett, Indian Scout
screenpixwesterns.us.description: During the 1840s, a wagon train is headed west with Davy Crockett (George Montgomery), a young man who shares a name with his famous frontiersman uncle, acting as one of the train's Native American scouts. After the passengers narrowly survive a series of ambushes from Native Americans, they come to believe that a spy is on board, helping plot the attacks. Suspicions fall on Davy's innocent partner, Red Hawk (Philip Reed), so he and Davy set out to find the real culprit. (Western) - 1950

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tomahawk Trail
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Cavalry veteran Sgt. Wade McCoy immediately butts heads with his new supervisor, Lt. Jonathan Davenport, over the latter's lack of experience on the treacherous route known as the "Tomahawk Trail," but Davenport's unfamiliarity with the territory proves deadly when a trip to Fort Bowie finds the troop under Apache attack. Crazy from the heat, Davenport turns on his men, forcing McCoy to go against his commanding officer in order to save the lives of others. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Winterhawk
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A Montana trapper (Leif Erickson) leads the search for a boy and a girl kidnapped by a noble Indian chief (Michael Dante). (Western) - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Adiós, Sabata
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) allies himself with a group of wily Mexican revolutionaries scheming to overthrow Emperor Maximilian and expel the occupying Austrians from their homeland. Part of their plan involves stealing a shipment of gold and using it to purchase artillery. It won't be easy, however, as the gold is under the protection of the corrupt and sadistic Col. Skimmel (Gerard Herter). As Sabata pulls off the daring heist, he must take on dozens of enraged Austrian forces. (Western) - 1970

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Return of Sabata
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The third in a trilogy about the eponymous lone gunman, this one finds Sabata (Lee Van Cleef) working as a sharpshooter for a circus that's just stopped in an ailing one-horse town. The circus gig is only a front, however: Sabata is actually on the verge of robbing town mayor Joe McIntock (Giampiero Albertini). The mayor's been levying heavy taxes as part of a complex plan to defraud the community, but Sabata manages to rip him off first, only to discover that the money is counterfeit. (Western) - 1971

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Ride Out for Revenge
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Under the eye of timid Capt. George (Lloyd Bridges), a group of Cheyenne Native Americans are on a forced march from their homelands to a reservation. When builders strike gold on their new settlement, the Cheyenne are diverted to make way for greedy prospectors. Tate (Rory Calhoun), who is secretly in love with Pretty Willow, is sent to scout a new location for the Cheyenne. Tensions quickly arise between the cavalry and the vengeful Chief Little Wolf (Vince Edwards). (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Iroquois Trail
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Trapper Hawkeye (George Montgomery) and guide Sagamore help a British captain (Glenn Langan) in the French and Indian War. (Western) - 1950

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Comanche
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Geronimo
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Apache leader Geronimo (Chuck Connors) tires of battling American and Mexican troops, and decides to surrender his meager tribe. However, life on the San Carlos reservation is difficult, and the Apaches do not adjust well to becoming farmers. Geronimo is befriended by a schoolteacher (Kamala Devi), who tries to broaden his horizons, but corruption on the reservation forces him to take his band and head for the mountains, where the Apaches wage a doomed war against the white man. (Western) - 1962

secnetwork.us.description: The No. 19 Ole Miss Rebels (6-3) visit the Oklahoma Sooners at Memorial Stadium in Norman for an SEC matchup. Ole Miss seek to rebound after a 42-7 loss to Georgia and rely on Trinidad Chambliss, while Oklahoma beat Florida 23-7 in Week 10.

secnetwork.us.description: News and information, hosted by Peter Burns, Dari Nowkhah or Alyssa Lang, joined by various network analysts, discussing all the SEC news of the day.

secnetwork.us.description: The No. 17 Gamecocks (6-3, 4-3) ride a four-game win streak into their SEC road test against the Razorbacks (3-6, 1-5). Two of those were away wins by a combined 36 points. South Carolina quarterback LaNorris Sellers has accounted for 24 TDs in 2026.
