showtimewomen.us.description: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border. (Comedy drama, Adventure, Romance) - 2001

showtimewomen.us.title: Twister
showtimewomen.us.description: During the approach of the most powerful storm in decades, university professor Dr. Jo Harding (Helen Hunt) and an underfunded team of students prepares the prototype for Dorothy, a ground-breaking tornado data-gathering device conceived by her estranged husband, Bill (Bill Paxton). When Harding tells Bill that Dorothy is ready for testing -- and that their privately funded rival Dr. Jonas Miller (Cary Elwes) has stolen the idea and built his own -- Bill rejoins the team for one last mission. (Action, Adventure) - 1996

showtimewomen.us.title: The English Patient
showtimewomen.us.description: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. (Romance, War, Historical drama) - 1996

shoxbetwest.us.title: Kickback
shoxbetwest.us.description: A documentary following the decades-long crusade of investigative journalist Andrew Jennings to expose corruption inside FIFA, football's sole governing body and the largest sports organization in the world. (Documentary) - 2022

shoxbetwest.us.title: Run
shoxbetwest.us.description: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration. - 2025

shoxbetwest.us.title: Persona
shoxbetwest.us.description: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them. - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Comeback Trail
shoxbetwest.us.description: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. - 2020

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Equalizer 2
shoxbetwest.us.description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him. - 2018

shoxbetwest.us.title: Sound of Violence
shoxbetwest.us.description: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain. - 2021

shoxbetwest.us.title: Bang Bang
shoxbetwest.us.description: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past. - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: Disgraced
shoxbetwest.us.description: An examination of the events surrounding the 2003 murder of Baylor University men's basketball star Patrick Dennehy. - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Silent Planet
shoxbetwest.us.description: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth. - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: Passion Play: Russell Westbrook
shoxbetwest.us.description: Rare footage and extensive interviews provide insight into the dynamic life and career of NBA player Russell Westbrook.

shoxbetwest.us.title: The One and Only Dick Gregory
shoxbetwest.us.description: Filmmaker Andre Gaines examines the remarkable life and career of stand-up comic, activist and pop culture icon Dick Gregory. Features interviews with Dave Chappelle, Chris Rock, Kevin Hart and others. - 2021

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
shoxbetwest.us.description: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him. - 2019

shoxbetwest.us.title: Attica
shoxbetwest.us.description: During the summer of 1971, tensions between inmates and guards at the Attica Correctional Facility are at an all-time high. On the morning of Sept. 9, it all comes to a head as Attica becomes the stage for one of the largest U.S. prison riots ever. - 2021

shoxbetwest.us.title: Love & Basketball
shoxbetwest.us.description: From childhood to early adulthood, two friends (Sanaa Lathan, Omar Epps) fall in love while trying to establish basketball careers. - 2000

shoxbetwest.us.title: Dreamgirls
shoxbetwest.us.description: After an ambitious manager (Jamie Foxx) gives them a shot at stardom, three singers learn that fame can carry a high personal cost. - 2006

shoxbetwest.us.title: Whitney: Can I Be Me
shoxbetwest.us.description: Filmmaker Nick Broomfield goes in search of the forces that made and then destroyed singer Whitney Houston, who has been described as having one of the greatest voices of the last 50 years. - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Nobody's Fool
shoxbetwest.us.description: After serving five years in prison, wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up, by-the-book sister Danica to help her get back on her feet. The feisty ex-con becomes suspicious and concerned when Danica tells her that she's in a long-distance, online relationship with a mysterious man she's never seen. As the polar opposites start to collide, Tanya soon discovers that her sibling's picture-perfect life may not be what it seems. (Romantic comedy) - 2018

shoxbetwest.us.title: Love & Basketball
shoxbetwest.us.description: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. (Romance, Drama) - 2000

shoxbetwest.us.title: Dreamgirls
shoxbetwest.us.description: Deena (Beyoncé Knowles), Effie (Jennifer Hudson) and Lorrell (Anika Noni Rose) form a music trio called the Dreamettes. When ambitious manager Curtis Taylor Jr. (Jamie Foxx) spots the act at a talent show, he offers the chance of a lifetime, to be backup singers for a national star (Eddie Murphy). Taylor takes creative control of the group and eventually pushes the singers into the spotlight. However, one becomes the star, forcing another out, which teaches them about the high cost of fame. (Musical, Drama) - 2006

shoxbetwest.us.title: Whitney: Can I Be Me
shoxbetwest.us.description: Filmmaker Nick Broomfield goes in search of the forces that made and then destroyed singer Whitney Houston, who has been described as having one of the greatest voices of the last 50 years. (Documentary, Music) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Burn Mother...ker, Burn!
shoxbetwest.us.description: A chronicle of how decades of troubled relations between the LAPD and the African-American community served as the prelude to the 1992 Los Angeles uprising. (Documentary) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: After Innocence
shoxbetwest.us.description: Following the stories of seven exonerated prisoners, "After Innocence" documents how DNA evidence led to the release of these wrongfully imprisoned, innocent men. Free after years -- and in some cases decades -- behind bars and on death row, these men struggle to transition back into society with inadequate support from the judicial system that wronged them. "After Innocence" brings to light flaws in the criminal justice system and the need for reform. (Documentary) - 2005

shoxbetwest.us.title: NYC Point Gods
shoxbetwest.us.description: Point guards including Rafer Alston, Kenny Anderson, Mark Jackson, Stephon Marbury, Kenny Smith and Rod Strickland hone their craft and taste for showmanship on New York City's iconic playgrounds and in high school gyms in the 1980s and '90s. (Special, Documentary, Basketball) - 2022-07-29

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rush Hour 2
shoxbetwest.us.description: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case. (Action, Comedy, Martial arts) - 2001

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rush Hour 3
shoxbetwest.us.description: East meets West when the assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord. (Action, Comedy, Martial arts) - 2007

shoxbetwest.us.title: One & Done: Ben Simmons
shoxbetwest.us.description: A young man finds success as a basketball player at LSU and prepares for the NBA Draft, in which he is expected to be selected. (Special, Documentary, Basketball) - 2016-10-21

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Heart Specialist
shoxbetwest.us.description: After following a former girlfriend to Florida, Ray Howard (Brian J. White) winds up as an intern in a not-so-prestigious teaching hospital. An unapologetic Lothario, Ray tries to work his charms on nurse Donna (Zoe Saldana), but she's already involved with the chief resident, Dr. Sidney Zachary (Wood Harris), who is also Ray's instructor. Sidney, who moonlights as a standup comic, decides that Ray needs to learn about true love, as well as medicine. (Romantic comedy) - 2006

shoxbetwest.us.title: Coach Carter
shoxbetwest.us.description: In 1999, Ken Carter (Samuel L. Jackson) returns to his old high school in Richmond, California, to get the basketball team into shape. With tough rules and academic discipline, he succeeds in setting the players on a winning streak. But when their grades start to suffer, Carter locks them out of the gym and shuts down their championship season. When he is criticized by the players and their parents, he sticks to his guns, determined that they excel in class as well as on the court. (Drama, Biography) - 2005

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Spencer goes back into the fantastical world of Jumanji, pals Martha, Fridge and Bethany re-enter the game to bring him home. But everything about Jumanji is about to change, as they soon discover more obstacles and more danger to overcome.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Golden Compass
skycinemafamily.uk.description: In a parallel universe, a young girl called Lyra comes into possession of a magical compass that is the beginning of an epic quest to save her world.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Borrowers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from 'Monster Family' to 'The Amazing Maurice'.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Karate Kid: Legends
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Rugrats Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Rugrats Go Wild
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
skycinemafamily.uk.description: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The BFG
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A 10-year-old girl, Queen Elizabeth II and the Big Friendly Giant must devise a plan to get rid of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and all the other bad giants once and for all.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenage daughter.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Addams Family
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Addams Family Values
skycinemafamily.uk.description: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Monster House
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young boy and his pals set out to discover what bloodcurdling secrets lie behind the front door of the scary house across the street.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Karate Kid: Legends
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Dog Man
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: There's trouble brewing in Bikini Bottom. Someone has stolen King Neptune's crown, and it looks like Mr. Krabs, SpongeBob's boss, is the culprit. Though he's just been passed over for the promotion of his dreams, SpongeBob stands by his boss, and along with his best pal Patrick, sets out on a treacherous mission to Shell City to reclaim the crown and save Mr. Krabs' life.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
skycinemafamily.uk.description: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Boss Baby
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven-year-old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Rugrats Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Rugrats Go Wild
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Madagascar
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Spoiled by their upbringing and with no idea of what wildlife is really like, Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Gloria the hippo and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap New York's Central Park Zoo for Madagascar.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The sequel to 'Madagascar', in which New York Zoo animals, Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Melman the Giraffe and Gloria the Hippo, still stranded on Madagascar, start to leave the island. All of a sudden, they land in the wilderness of Africa, where Alex meets the rest of his family, but has trouble communicating with them after spending so much time at the Central Park Zoo. A DreamWorks animation.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

skykids.uk.description: Making Lemonade Out of Lemons: While running a lemonade stand to raise money for new football jerseys, the gang discover that they can achieve anything when they work together! (S1, ep 17)

skykids.uk.title: Tickety Toc

skykids.uk.description: Pingu the Mountaineer / Pingu Shows Off What He Can Do: Pingu and Father start to climb a mountain, but Pingu soon gets tired. Pingu ignores Pinga while trying to impress Pingi. (S2, ep 16)

sportsmanchannel.us.title: North American Whitetail - Two States, Two Bucks: Dr. Deer's Southern Whitetail Quest
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Dr. James Kroll hunts prime whitetail country in Kentucky and Louisiana, highlighting food plots, box blinds, habitat work and encounters with mature bucks. (Outdoors, Hunting) - 2026-07-07

sportsmanchannel.us.title: North American Whitetail - Crossbow Country: Stan Potts in Illinois
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Stan Potts bowhunts Illinois whitetails with a crossbow, using early-season deer movement and a well-placed setup to close the deal on a Midwest buck. (Outdoors, Hunting) - 2026-07-28

sportsmanchannel.us.title: North American Whitetail - Virginia Hardwoods: Blake Garlock's Buck Hunt
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Blake Garlock hunts Virginia deer country, where thick cover, hardwood ridges, timber edges, and careful setups create the perfect chance at a mature buck. (Outdoors, Hunting) - 2026-07-21

sportsmanchannel.us.title: North American Whitetail - R Legacy Rifle Country with Blake Garlock
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Blake Garlock hunts R Legacy, where open-country deer movement, brushy cover, food sources and a well-placed blind produce a mature whitetail. (Outdoors, Hunting) - 2026-08-25

sportsmanchannel.us.title: North American Whitetail - Northern Grit: The Shelton Boys' Whitetail Pursuit
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Haynes Shelton and his father face tough northern conditions in a late-season whitetail hunt packed with cold-weather strategy, close encounters, and giant buck action. (Outdoors, Hunting) - 2026-06-29

sportsmanchannel.us.title: The Trail - The Return
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Laramy finishes packing and loading his gear on Seven and Jensen and sets out on the trail to return home; after a joyful reunion with his family, Laramy creates a keepsake for his daughter using his tanned elk hide.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Dead Meat - What's a Nilgai?
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Leysath welcomes his son Jake to chase an invasive Asian antelope in South Texas; nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology; the group takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for speckled trout.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Trijicon's World of Sports Afield - Team Hornady Takes On New Zealand pt 1
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Team Hornady Heads to New Zealand's SouthIsland on a high country hunt for some of NewZealand's most prized species.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Hornady's Dark and Dangerous - Double Rifles & Buffalo Country
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Tony Perkins faces buffalo in Matetsi, Buzz Charlton begins his Big Four hunt with a Rigby double rifle, and Tim Herald adds another buffalo in Uganda.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: MeatEater - Hawaii Spearfishing
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Steve and Ryan Callaghan meet with Kimi Werner and Danny Bolton on the Big Island to dive in the deep blue for mahi mahi and wahoo.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Man Eats Wild - Columbian Cowboys
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Mario heads to the Flatlands of Columbia where he teams up with cowboys and goes in search of electric eels.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Chasing the 29 - A Michigan Whitetail Bow Hunt
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Following Chase as he spends time on his home turf, chasing whitetail with a bow in hand; from the quiet mornings in the Michigan woods, to the anticipation of a perfect opportunity, this hunt brings the pursuit back home.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: The Trail - The Return
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Laramy finishes packing and loading his gear on Seven and Jensen and sets out on the trail to return home; after a joyful reunion with his family, Laramy creates a keepsake for his daughter using his tanned elk hide.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: The Most Wanted List - Home Sweet Harm
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Season 12 concludes with Lee and Kristy home in Texas for the holidays, where Kristy welcomes family to hunt their first whitetail.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Winchester Deadly Passion - Iowa
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Sometimes the third time's a charm and that couldn't be more true for Melissa on this Iowa hunt; after two past attempts, the wait is finally over!

tbswest.us.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
tbswest.us.description: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. He watches gleefully from his perch on the mountain above, sure that when the Whos awake and see that their holiday decorations, gifts and feast are gone, they will be sad. To his surprise, the Whos celebrate anyway, leading to an unexpected response from the Grinch. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Special, Comedy) - 1966-12-18

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Time Jerker
teennick.us.description: When Kid Danger and Captain Man battle the Time Jerker, Kid Danger accidentally falls into the Time Jerker's time machine and relives the same day over again. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-11-07

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Opposite Universe
teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte travel to an opposite universe where evil counterparts of Ray and Schwoz want to destroy Piper. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-04-16

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Secret Beef
teennick.us.description: Henry receives an invitation to Swellview's most exclusive restaurant, and decides to bring his boss, Ray. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-11-14

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Jasper Danger
teennick.us.description: When Jasper dresses as Kid Danger for Halloween, a case of mistaken identity causes the real Kid Danger and Captain Man to come to his rescue. (Children, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2014-10-18

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Man: On Vacation
teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte are in charge of protecting Swellview while Ray is out of town at his cousin's wedding. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-10-10

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Stuck in Two Holes
teennick.us.description: Charlotte and Jasper must come to the rescue when Captain Man and Kid Danger are each stuck in a hole. (Children, Comedy) - 2017-04-29

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Secret Room
teennick.us.description: Captain Man reveals a Crime fighters Only room in the Man Cave; when Charlotte, Jasper and Schwoz make a cooler room to show them up, the gang fights over who gets the better room and things get blown out of proportion. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-03-02

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Super Volcano
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray think the world is ending when a dormant super volcano under Swellview becomes active; Piper is convinced that she has gluten intolerance. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-02-07

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Story Tank
teennick.us.description: Big steaks are on the line when Henry claims he can't be scared; Schwoz uses a machine that allows Henry to virtually experience the spooky stories that everyone in the Man Cave tells him in an attempt to prove Henry wrong. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-10-12

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Man of the House
teennick.us.description: After Henry's mother's purse is stolen, Captain Man decides he must move in with Henry's family in order to protect them. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-03-14

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Invisible Brad
teennick.us.description: Captain Man's friend, who was accidentally turned invisible, shows up for a visit, but quickly overstays his welcome. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-01-10

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Twin Henrys
teennick.us.description: Henry has a shape-shifting android fill in at a family dinner so that he can watch an MMA fight with Charlotte and Ray. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-05-07

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Game of Phones
teennick.us.description: When a young girl chains herself outside Junk-N-Stuff, Kid Danger and Captain Man are forced to help find her beloved phone; while on a stakeout, they unexpectedly run across some familiar faces with a devious plan. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-02-15

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Toddler Invasion
teennick.us.description: When the Toddler takes control of the Man Cave, Charlotte and Jasper have to find a way to sneak in and free Kid Danger and Captain Man. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-05

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Budget Cuts
teennick.us.description: When the Vice Mayor cuts Captain Man and Kid Danger's budget to build a high-speed railway in Swellview, the duo must figure out creative ways to save money. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-04-07

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Flabber Gassed
teennick.us.description: After acting too confident before a fight, Kid Danger and Captain Man are sprayed with Flabber Gas making them powerless to defeat a new villain in Swellview; Schwoz puts the heroes in Exo-Suits which Charlotte and Jasper control. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-10-20

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Rubber Duck
teennick.us.description: When Ray accidentally destroys Henry's dad's prized remote control car, they throw a manicure/pedicure party to raise money to fix it. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-10-13

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Man-kini
teennick.us.description: When a new internet celebrity causes havoc in Swellview, Captain Man has to swap bodies with Frankini to infiltrate his secret lair. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-12

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Double-O Danger
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man attempt to capture mob boss Rob Moss by infiltrating his daughter's Sweet 16 birthday party. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-06-29

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Dream Busters
teennick.us.description: A villain's dream beam traps Henry in a dream state from which only Charlotte can rescue him. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-03-21

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Dodging Danger
teennick.us.description: After Henry uses his new power to compete in a Dodge-A-Leen tournament, Ray, Schwoz and Charlotte go undercover to teach Henry a lesson. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-12-03

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - April Fools Rules; Cereal Offender
teennick.us.description: Luna pranks the entire household every year on April Fools' Day, but this year Lincoln has a plan to avoid her pranks; the Loud children make a trip to the supermarket to do the grocery shopping for their mother, but Lincoln has other plans. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-09-28

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Hand-Me-Downer; Sleuth or Consequences
teennick.us.description: After Lincoln gets a pink hand-me-down bike from Lori, he borrows Lynn's cool BMX bike without telling her; when someone clogs the toilet, Lincoln investigates to find the culprit. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-17

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Zach Attack; Flying Solo
teennick.us.description: Zach and Rusty fake an alien landing, which sends the whole town on a hunt for little green men; Clyde thinks he's guaranteed the Glee Club solo, until Lincoln accidentally auditions and lands the part. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2021-02-08

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Time Trap!
teennick.us.description: When the kids break Mom and Dad's priceless vase, they decide the only thing to do is go back in time to their wedding day and prevent them from ever receiving it. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-06-03

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Save Royal Woods!
teennick.us.description: When Royal Woods is in danger of being flooded to make room for a sixth Great Lake, the town comes together to prove that they're worth saving. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-07-01

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Good Sports; Geri-Antics
teennick.us.description: Lynn finds an unexpected TV sports-watching buddy in the family's next-door neighbor, Mr. Grouse; when Lisa realizes that Pop Pop won't be around forever, she turns to science to ensure his longevity. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-11-16

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Snow Way Out; Snow Way Down
teennick.us.description: Lana convinces the children to go to the Burpin' Burger to meet her racecar driving hero despite the heavy snowfall; when Lincoln goes on vacation with Clyde, he realizes how overprotective Clyde's parents are. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2017-12-01

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Washed Up; Recipe for Disaster
teennick.us.description: The Louds rent a boat for a relaxing day trip on the lake, but the family ends up marooned on a desert island; Lincoln and Clyde, as Ace and Jack, investigate when they discover a frozen food company is using Dad's recipes. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-07-16

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Road Trip: From Brad to Worse; Road Trip: Doll Day Afternoon
teennick.us.description: When the Louds run into Mom's old camp crush turned celebrity at a State Fair, Dad tries to one-up him to impress Rita; Mr. Coconuts is missing and Luan rallies the Louds to track him down along Route 66. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2023-07-14

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - A Star Is Scorned; Senior Moment
teennick.us.description: Lola realizes that double the cuteness could help her break into show business, so she teams up with Lily; Lori vows to make up for lost time in her senior year. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2021-06-18

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Space Jammed; Crown and Dirty
teennick.us.description: Annoyed by Leni's intrusive babysitting, Lisa accidentally blasts herself and Todd into space; Lola tries to whip Mom into tip-top pageant condition for a mother-daughter pageant. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-09-16

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Meet Cute Crush
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray try to help Piper get to know a new boy she likes from school. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-02-10

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Cave the Date
teennick.us.description: Henry and the gang set up a secret underground restaurant in the Man Cave for Charlotte's private dinner with music superstar Jack Swagger; when word gets out that Jack Swagger is in town, some unwanted guests crash the party. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-02-01

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Drex
teennick.us.description: Captain Man's old sidekick and nemesis, Drex, returns from the past with an army of cavemen to finish off Captain Man once and for all; Kid Danger may be the only one who can save Captain Man. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-03-07

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Diamonds Are for Heather
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man are called to the Swellview Museum of Stools and Jewels to prevent the rare Neal Diamond from being stolen. (Children, Science fiction) - 2018-04-14

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Up the Stairs!
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray's friendship is put to the ultimate test when they have to endure the half-mile trek up the Man Cave stairs in order to make a surprise meal by a celebrity chef in Junk-N-Stuff. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-10-06

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Tears of the Jolly Beetle
teennick.us.description: When Captain Man loses his powers of invulnerability and becomes too afraid to fight crime, Kid Danger must keep Swellview safe. (Children, Sitcom) - 2014-09-27

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Elevator Kiss
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger rescues Bianca, and they share a kiss; Henry is upset when he realizes that Bianca kissed Kid Danger. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-03-07

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Toon in for Danger
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray get a copy of the new Kid Danger and Captain Man cartoon and see that it's horrible; they must hurry to fix the cartoon before the big premiere party. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-01-15

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - EnvyGram Wall
teennick.us.description: Captain Man and Kid Danger guard Swellview's newest attraction, the EnvyGram Wall; when Captain Man destroys the wall while trying to eliminate a small bird, Kid Danger and Captain Man have to figure out a way to replace it. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-11-16

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - I Know Your Secret
teennick.us.description: When Henry receives a series of mysterious notes from someone, he begins to worry that the sender may know his secret identity. (Children, Sitcom, Comedy) - 2016-07-17

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Green Fingers
teennick.us.description: After Schwoz creates a disease that accidentally affects Charlotte, Henry, his family, and even Ray, he quarantines them in Henry's house in order to find a cure. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-04-22

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - A Tale of Two Pipers
teennick.us.description: Henry gets an unexpected visitor claiming to be from the future; when a boy-robot killing machine steps onto the scene, the gang must find a way to save everyone from an apocalyptic future. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-10-05

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Love Muffin
teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte discover things are not what they seem when Captain Man suddenly announces his plans to marry. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-09-24

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 3
themoviechannel.us.description: In the final installment of this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer. (Horror, Comedy, Mystery) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
themoviechannel.us.description: Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen), a rather clueless police detective, tries to foil a plot to turn innocent people into assassins through mind control. After his partner, Norberg (O.J. Simpson), is shot, Frank sets out to find the culprit, leading him to business tycoon Vincent Ludwig (Ricardo Montalban). However, Frank has no evidence until he meets Jane Spencer (Priscilla Presley), Ludwig's assistant. She knows nothing about Ludwig's devious plans, but falls for Frank and agrees to help him. (Comedy) - 1988

themoviechannel.us.title: Old School
themoviechannel.us.description: Three friends try to recapture the fun of their college years by starting their own off-campus fraternity. - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike
themoviechannel.us.description: A male stripper takes a newcomer under his wing and instructs him in the fine arts of partying, picking up women and making plenty of money. - 2012

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike XXL
themoviechannel.us.description: Three years after retiring from stripping, Mike Lane (Channing Tatum) reunites with the rest of the Kings of Tampa (Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello) for one final, outrageous performance in Myrtle Beach, S.C. - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Private Parts
themoviechannel.us.description: Howard Stern (Howard Stern) recalls his personal life and the controversial style that made him a radio celebrity. - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 2
themoviechannel.us.description: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college. - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Flight of the Intruder
themoviechannel.us.description: Two Navy pilots (Willem Dafoe, Brad Johnson) hatch a rogue mission to bomb Hanoi with a special low-altitude plane. - 1991

themoviechannel.us.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
themoviechannel.us.description: A beautiful globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) battles otherworldly creatures for possession of a powerful artifact. - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Flypaper
themoviechannel.us.description: A man tries to protect a teller, whom he secretly loves, after two groups rob her bank at the same time. - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: Election
themoviechannel.us.description: Tracy faces no competition in her high school election, but the civics teacher intervenes by encouraging the varsity football player to run for president, resulting in chaos. - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The Comeback Trail
themoviechannel.us.description: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Urban Cowboy
themoviechannel.us.description: A Texas farmer (John Travolta) moves to the city, immerses himself in honky-tonk and falls for a sexy cowgirl (Debra Winger). - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: The Aviator
themoviechannel.us.description: During the 1930s and '40s, wealthy industrialist Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) gains fame as a movie producer, airplane designer and pilot. - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
themoviechannel.us.description: An attractive lawyer and Bridget's (Renée Zellweger) former boss (Hugh Grant) threaten her newfound happiness with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth). - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: An Unfinished Life
themoviechannel.us.description: Old wounds get a chance to heal when a Wyoming rancher (Robert Redford) shelters his abused daughter-in-law (Jennifer Lopez) and her child. - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Terms of Endearment
themoviechannel.us.description: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children. (Comedy drama) - 1983

themoviechannel.us.title: The Terminal
themoviechannel.us.description: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal? (Comedy drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Super
themoviechannel.us.description: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante. (Action, Comedy) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Urban Cowboy
themoviechannel.us.description: After moving to Pasadena, Texas, country boy Bud Davis starts hanging around a bar called Gilley's, where he falls in love with Sissy, a cowgirl who believes the sexes are equal. They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles. Jealousy over his rival, Wes, leads to their separation, but Bud attempts to win Sissy back by triumphing at Gilley's mechanical bull-riding competition. (Drama) - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: Our Friend
themoviechannel.us.description: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home. (Drama) - 2019

themoviechannel.us.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
themoviechannel.us.description: When the Mason family moves to idyllic Palos Verdes, Calif., the father, Phil, loves it but the mother, Sandy, feels out of place among the fake tans and tennis skirts. Phil and Sandy's daughter, Medina, is a loner and outcast at school, while her charismatic brother, Jim, is effortlessly popular. When Medina and Jim take up surfing, they must prove their right to share the waves with the tough Bayboys gang that monopolizes their stretch of beach. (Comedy drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Proof
themoviechannel.us.description: Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Sleeping Dogs
themoviechannel.us.description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear
themoviechannel.us.description: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1996

theweatherchannel.us.title: World's Deadliest Weather - Dorian Disaster
theweatherchannel.us.description: The Bahamas get pounded by 200mph winds during category five Hurricane Dorian - the most intense cyclone the country has ever seen; in Arizona, flash flooding sweeps a couple away resulting in a heart-stopping rescue. (Documentary, Weather)

tnt.us.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
tnt.us.description: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. He watches gleefully from his perch on the mountain above, sure that when the Whos awake and see that their holiday decorations, gifts and feast are gone, they will be sad. To his surprise, the Whos celebrate anyway, leading to an unexpected response from the Grinch. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Special, Comedy) - 1966-12-18

tnt.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus
tnt.us.description: Sidelined by a nasty cold and feeling unneeded, Santa decides not to make his annual Christmas journey. Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Special, Fantasy) - 1974-12-10

From the start, the married lawyer is drawn to the enigmatic beauty, and he begins to cast about for a way to exonerate his client. Keane puts Andre Latour (Louis Jourdan), the Paradine household servant, on the stand, suggesting he is the killer. But Keane soon loses his way in the courtroom, and his half-baked plan sets off a stunning chain of events. (Drama) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Hidden Fortress
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Japanese peasants Matashichi (Kamatari Fujiwara) and Tahei (Minoru Chiaki) try and fail to make a profit from a tribal war. They find a man and woman whom they believe are simple tribe members hiding in a fortress. Although the peasants don't know that Rokurota (Toshirô Mifune) is a general and Yuki (Misa Uehara) is a princess, the peasants agree to accompany the pair to safety in return for gold. Along the way, the general must prove his expertise in battle while also hiding his identity. (Comedy) - 1958

En route to a safe zone, Yoshitsune and his bodyguards must pass through a heavily garrisoned mountain stronghold held by his brother's forces. Hopelessly outnumbered, Yoshitsune and his guards, led by samurai Benkei (Denjirô Ôkôchi), decided that the safest way to pass through the checkpoint unharmed was to dress themselves as monks. (Drama, Adventure) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Divorce of Lady X

Charmed by Leslie even after she tricks him into giving up his bedroom and pajamas, Everard becomes infatuated, despite his suspicion that she is married. When Lord Mere (Ralph Richardson) engages Everard to file for divorce against his wife, who met a man at the hotel, Everard fears he may be the other man. (Comedy) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Woman Wanted

Ann escapes and ends up in the vehicle of Tony Baxter (Joel McCrea), a lawyer who has eyes for her. Tony realizes Ann is innocent, so he vows to help her prove it, risking his neck in the process. Tony and Ann are pursued by the police and by Smiley Gordon (Louis Calhern), a mob boss who engineered Ann's escape thinking that she can lead him to a $250,000 stash. (Crime drama) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Young Man With Ideas

He eventually opts for a drastic change and moves his family to California to start over. Studying to pass the state's bar exam, Maxwell endures numerous hardships while trying to make ends meet, even becoming involved in questionable schemes. When he gets into trouble for being associated with a bookie, Maxwell has to use his legal skills to defend himself. (Comedy drama) - 1952

A gambler in debt, Terence Keath (Robert Walker), pursues her. turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Just This Once

history.ca.title: The UnXplained - Buried Mysteries
history.ca.description: Across the deserts of North Africa and the Near East--the region often called one of the Cradles of Civilization--entire armies, cities, and cultures have vanished beneath shifting sands. From a Persian force lost in the Great Sand Sea to buried Sumerian and Arabian cities that may have inspired enduring legends, new discoveries continue to challenge what we know about humanity's earliest empires, sacred stories and ancient beliefs. (Paranormal, Documentary) - 2026-08-21

moremax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
moremax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: The Nun
moremax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
moremax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. - 2024

moremax.us.title: The Predator
moremax.us.description: In Shane Black's explosive reinvention, the Predator is deadlier than ever, and only a ragtag crew can prevent the end of the human race. - 2018

moremax.us.title: Nerve
moremax.us.description: Partnered with a mysterious stranger (Dave Franco), a high school senior (Emma Roberts) joins a popular online game that dares players to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. - 2016

moremax.us.title: Scream
moremax.us.description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity. - 1996

moremax.us.title: Girls Trip
moremax.us.description: Four best friends travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. - 2017

moremax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
moremax.us.description: Twentieth-century teenagers (Leonardo DiCaprio, Claire Danes) fall in love, despite feuding families, in an update of the classic tragedy. - 1996

moremax.us.title: Architecton
moremax.us.description: A hypnotic, propulsive odyssey through the foundations of the modern world, following mountains as they are turned into concrete and buildings as they are turned into rubble. - 2024

moremax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
moremax.us.description: Trapped in digital space by a rogue AI, superstar LeBron James teams up with Bugs Bunny and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. - 2021

moremax.us.title: The Hobbit
moremax.us.description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. - 1977

moremax.us.title: Fantastic Beasts: A Natural History
moremax.us.description: Delving into the mythological, including dragons, mermaids, and unicorns -- alongside examinations of natural world beasts, such as vervet monkeys, narwhals, and manatees; Stephen Fry travels far and wide to learn about such animals.

moremax.us.title: The Mountain Between Us
moremax.us.description: Stranded on a mountain after a plane crash, two strangers must work together to survive the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles. - 2017

moremax.us.title: The Way, Way Back
moremax.us.description: After his mother's lover (Steve Carell) belittles him, a boy (Liam James) befriends a water-park employee (Sam Rockwell) who helps give him the confidence to come out of his shell. - 2013

moremax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: A scientist's quest to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease unintentionally results in a highly intelligent chimpanzee, which may signal the end of man's dominion over Earth. - 2011

moremax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Human survivors of a plague threaten Caesar's growing nation of genetically evolved apes. Though they reach a fragile peace, soon both sides are brought to the brink of a war that will determine which will become Earth's dominant species. - 2014

moremax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes. - 2017

moremax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

moremax.us.title: The Flash
moremax.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Mickey 17
moremax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Contagion
moremax.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Daytrippers
moremax.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

moremax.us.title: Adult Best Friends
moremax.us.description: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (Comedy) - 2024

moremax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
moremax.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

moremax.us.title: They All Laughed
moremax.us.description: The employees of New York City's Odyssey Detective Agency can't seem to prevent themselves from getting over-involved in their clients' lives. When aging gumshoe John Russo (Ben Gazzara) is assigned to trail an Italian millionaire's wife, Angela (Audrey Hepburn), he inevitably falls for her continental charm. His partner, Charles (John Ritter), is similarly unable to keep his hands off the woman he's trailing -- a winsome cheating spouse named Dolores (Dorothy Stratten). (Romantic comedy) - 1981

moremax.us.title: Shazam!
moremax.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
moremax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Remarkable Places To Eat
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Puglia TV and radio host, Dermot O'Leary takes Fred Sirieix to Puglia in Italy's deep South to his favourite restaurants showcasing simple but sublime cucina povera, or poor man's cooking.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Amalul's Pandan Bubble Tea Amalul, Alimah's granddaughter, is a self-proclaimed bubble tea connoisseur. She shares her bright bubble tea brew and pays tribute to the vibrant and flavourful pandanus leaf.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Flying Fish Five months on the new Sydney Fish Market faces its greatest test: a bleak winter and shrinking seafood supply. From crocodile waters to the Chatham Islands, fishers and merchants battle distance.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Malaysia And Sri Lanka Rick is spoilt for choice as he explores the multi-faceted food of Penang, an appealing mix of Malay, Indian and Chinese with a bit of British charm thrown in for good measure.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E6 A Royal Taste Of Jordan Gordon digs deep into the verdant north and arid south of Jordan to discover rich, fresh flavours as he prepares to impress royalty at Petra.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Gozo Ainsley heads to the idyllic island of Gozo to finish his journey, starting with a picturesque picnic filled with the tastes of Malta courtesy of Ana.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Hainanese Chicken The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 The Ass Crack Of Dawn In New York City It's last call and you're hungry. What do you do? Luckily, you're in New York City, where your crew can choose from mouth-watering options like Korean BBQ, empanadas, and birria.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Feast By Fire
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Breaking The Cut In Austin, Jess visits Leroy and Lewis Barbecue, where lesser-known cuts like top blade are given the spotlight.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Thai Street Food: Best Kept Secrets
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Roots Of Thai Fire From a mother and daughter dumpling shop, to hand-made hill-tribe snacks, these spicy & savoury street food snacks expose the roots and global influences that have shaped the Thai food we know today.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Global Soul Kitchen

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E31 Episode 31 Laura proves her title as the Pasta Queen with her Timballo Pasta. Veggie Farmer Catherine Velisha brings a Roasted Broccoli with Butter Bean Puree dish that is chockfull of vegetables.
