waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Bowhunting Kansas
waypointtv.us.description: S20 E07 Tyler Jordan hunts with Perry Ross of Ross Trophy Outfitters.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Undertaker Hunting Sandhill Cranes- Catch Clean Cook- Ribeye of the Sky Recipe
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E29 WWE's Mark Calaway, aka "Undertaker," joins Realtree's David Blanton for a sandhill crane hunt in Texas. The crew put the Franchi Shotguns to work and harvested the "Ribeye of the Sky."

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Monster Buck in Nebraska; October Bow Hunting
waypointtv.us.description: Join Tyler Jordan, Brandon Sheppard and Brantley Richardson as they hit the woods in Georgia during the peak of the November rut! Then, Tyler heads to Kansas in search of big Midwestern bucks.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Hunting Tough Alabama Turkeys; Big Gobbler Finally Breaks; Realtree Road Trips
waypointtv.us.description: Join Tyler Jordan, Brandon Sheppard and Brantley Richardson as they hit the woods in Georgia during the peak of the November rut! Then, Tyler heads to Kansas in search of big Midwestern bucks.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird
waypointtv.us.description: Randy is getting the last food plot of the season in down at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma. Then opening day of the 2025 bow season starts off in an unusual way for the crew. Randy smokes a Hog and Nate Has a really close call with one of the target.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : The Raven Project - Summer Prep And Randy Raven Bow Kill
waypointtv.us.description: Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast-forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : The Raven Project - Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird Part 2
waypointtv.us.description: Nate catches up with the Oklahoma buck that he had the close call with, and Cody is able to close the chapter with a buck he has been after for a few seasons.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : The Raven Project - Summer Maintenance And Hog Hunting
waypointtv.us.description: Randy and his brother Cody are at the Dirty Bird ranch in Oklahoma doing some summer time maintenance and trying their best to control the hog population by doing a little hog hunting.

waypointtv.us.title: The Cast : Table Rock Tradition
waypointtv.us.description: The Cast aims to reveal various angling experiences tied to a deeper meaning through the lens of personal experiences; from fresh water in the Midwest, to exploring the saltwater of the coasts.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Florida Bay Variety, Continued
waypointtv.us.description: S20 E08 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor continue to fish Florida Bay out of Hawks Cay, catching an incredible variety of flats species including tarpon, snook, redfish, trout and bonefish.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Marquesas Mixed Bag With Captain Bryson Shaaber
waypointtv.us.description: S20 E09 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head down to Key West to sample different fishing opportunities in the Marquesas Keys with Captain Bryson Shaaber.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Double Slam With Captain Nick LaBadie
waypointtv.us.description: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor meet up with Captain Nick LaBadie at Big Pine Key for an action-packed day. They're out on the flats chasing tarpon, bonefish, and permit for the elusive Grand Slam.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Goliaths Under the Bushes

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Tarpon in the Key West Channels
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E03 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor join Captain Bryson Shaaber to fish the channels around Key West, targeting big spring tarpon with live pinfish bait.

waypointtv.us.title: Reel Animals

waypointtv.us.title: Goin' Coastal
waypointtv.us.description: Anglers showcase different fishing techniques, share valuable tips, and uncover hidden hotspots.

waypointtv.us.title: Sail Kings : The Prodigal Son

waypointtv.us.title: Sail Kings : Variety Pack
waypointtv.us.description: Captain Jared Raskob and guest Captain Jimmy Hendricks face challenges from sharks during a fishing trip; the pair adapts their techniques to successfully catch their target species.

waypointtv.us.description: CA and Chris Wittman explore the Everglades and recount some of Captains for Clean Water's history.

waypointtv.us.description: Danny Pruitt travels around the country fishing in some of the nation's best kept secrets all while discovering the communities, culture, food, and the people that make each episode unique and entertaining.

waypointtv.us.title: Chasin' the Sun : Billfish Open Rebirth

waypointtv.us.title: Chasin' the Sun : A Bridge Too Red

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Sables
waypointtv.us.description: Texas is a land rich and plentiful, and one of the country's most sought-out destinations to hunt wild game; its hunting culture is driven by family and values, and the trophy itself is embedded within the experience.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Border Bucks
waypointtv.us.description: S02 E05 Every year, hunters from across the country flock to various parts of Texas to extend their hunting season; friends from Struttinbuck do just the same, as Matt and Clede make the long drive to Del Rio to hunt South Texas bucks on the Mexico border.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In February of 1996, New Jersey millionaire Frank Black flew to Florida to close a major business deal before retiring. He never came home. Authorities in New Jersey sensed foul play and brought in the FBI. Agents learned of a mystery woman in Florida who was to meet Black. Phone records showed a flood of calls to Black from his business rival just before the disappearance.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1997, FBI agents began investigating New York gas station mogul Gurmeet Dhinsa for gas pump rigging. They soon realized that Dhinsa was more than a crooked businessman, he enforced his mob-like operation with brutal violence, kidnapping and killing errant employees and any family members who questioned their deaths. FBI agents worked their way into Dhinsa's violent world.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1980s, the decapitation of a young African-American male led the Miami-Dade police department and the FBI along a trail of murder. Investigators quickly discovered that the victim was a dissident member of a religious sect headed by a man calling himself Yahweh ben Yahweh, or God, Son of God. Although the FBI believed Yahweh ben Yahweh and his followers were responsible for many murders, they could find no direct evidence linking them to the crimes.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In November of 1994, when a Wells Fargo armored van disappeared from a Glendale, Arizona mall, local authorities and the FBI scrambled to recover it, and its cargo of nearly a million dollars. Six hours later, agents found the van, its driver shot dead inside and the money gone. It was a perfect hit by professionals who left no clue behind. Months passed before a solid lead developed. In January, a tip led agents to look into a former prison guard.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Beginning in California in 1995, a serial killer targeted vulnerable women. At first charming and generous, he quickly became violent. He was brutal with his kills and quick in his getaways. Traveling across the country, he struck in Mississippi, Louisiana and Florida. The FBI and local police needed to stop this cross-country killer before more women fell victim to his insatiable rage.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1987, a successful television producer was gunned down in his New York office. It looked like a professional hit. With no leads, the investigation stalled. Four years later and a continent away, a man told Los Angeles police he had been hired to murder two exotic dancers. Investigators linked the two crimes and uncovered a businessman willing to kill to protect his interests.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A 1981 armored car robbery near New York City left one guard dead and another critically wounded. Police stopped suspects nearby and another shoot-out ensued, claiming the lives of two officers. Local police and the FBI suspected a large group of domestic terrorists with a history of violent crime. They would try to ferret out these heavily armed criminals who moved in a shadowy underworld and were not afraid to kill authorities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a California man was found dismembered in 1990, police suspected a local burglar, but they couldn't find him. Six months later, he was caught robbing an Arizona bank and sentenced to life. But prison couldn't hold him for long, and within a year he escaped. The FBI would lead a multi-agency manhunt for a killer on a desperate run through the tourist regions of the west.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At first it seemed like a tragic hunting accident when 18-year-old David Wilkey was shot to death in rural Virginia in 1983. A tenacious insurance investigator suspected foul play, but he had no direct evidence. Two years later a man contacted North Carolina FBI agents with a complex story of conspiracy and murder-for-hire: he claimed he had been hired to murder Wilkey's killer.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On a summer night in 1990, a body was discovered burning in a Minnesota alley. Weeks later, police finally identified the victim, a suspected drug courier from California. The FBI began working with local police and slowly uncovered a multi-state crime ring run by a deadly drug lord who used violence and intimidation to keep those around him silent. Agents needed to infiltrate and dismantle the crew before more people died.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1990's drug gangs terrorized Harlem, New York neighborhoods. When a 10-year-old boy fell victim in the crossfire, NYPD detectives and FBI agents clamped down on the problem. They formed a task force called C-11, designed to dismantle the gangs. In an environment of violence and fear it would be difficult to identify, arrest and convict those involved in the secretive and deadly world of big money drugs.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1994, a teenage immigrant came to the United States to realize her dream of becoming a doctor. But a tragic twist of fate intervened, when she found herself an innocent victim of the drug trade. Kidnapped and held captive, she survived for days against all odds. Authorities arrested her captors, but they refused to reveal her whereabouts. The FBI and local police raced against time, determined to save the teenager's life. Their investigation revealed a complex story of drugs, betrayal and revenge.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the mid-1990's, a gang of professional bank robbers raided cities across seven states. Disguises and speed protected their identity from cameras and the police as they stole hundreds of thousands of dollars, always leaving a bomb to terrorize their victims. The stakes were raised when the FBI discovered the robbers had an agenda beyond their personal wealth. To stop these extremists and their growing operation, the FBI needed to capture their leaders.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A Labor Day weekend turned into a nightmare of murder as a cross-country crime spree terrorized the nation. In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenage boy disappeared within hours of each other. Police believed the cases were linked, but didn't know how. They contacted the FBI for help. A trail of stolen vehicles and murder victims across seven states led agents on a hunt for two suspected killers. Their only hope of stopping them was to anticipate the killers' next move.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A day that began with a class field trip ended with a parent's worst nightmare. An 11-year-old girl was missing. Her parents were certain she was no runaway. When they failed to find her in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police. The FBI soon joined the investigation and family and friends worked with detectives and agents in an urgent search for the missing girl. Faced with conflicting witness reports and false leads, agents wouldn't stop until they found the girl, and the truth.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the summer of 1988, a wealthy Jackson, Mississippi woman disappeared from her home in broad daylight. Left behind was a mysterious ransom note listing twelve names and no specific instructions. The note, and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate. FBI and local police struggled to find answers in the cryptic message so they could find the kidnapper and retrieve the victim before her time ran out. Solving the crime required the keen insight of a criminal profiler and the perseverance of a family, local authorities, and the FBI.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Arizona, a shipment of money vanished into the high desert, along with the two men hired to guard it. The FBI didn't know if the guards were participants or victims of an ambush. Answers lay somewhere in the thousands of square miles of Arizona's northwest territory. When the vehicle was recovered with three hundred thousand dollars and the drivers missing, suspicions that the crime was an inside job grew.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Alabama, a pair of convicted felons escaped the custody of a local deputy and fled across the country. Eluding authorities, they moved from state to state in a wave of abduction and car theft. When a foreign military officer disappeared along their trail, police and FBI agents wondered if the armed fugitives had become killers. Agents believed the pair were growing more violent and raced to find the escapees before more victims crossed their path.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1992, a young mother was gunned down in front of her children. Police searched for answers, but found none. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless, and random. Then, family members offered a startling clue. The victim, the wife of a prominent Atlanta attorney, was also a woman burdened with a secret; a secret the FBI believed led to her death. It would force local and federal agents to untangle an intricate web of money, drugs and murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Memphis, Tennessee, a horrible crime terrified local residents. When a wealthy young mother was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The twenty-five year old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband, and several spurned boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list. To find the woman and her abductor, investigators would have to first determine the motive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1997, a series of crimes in a small Iowa farming community left residents reeling in shock and fear. Two young men went on a crime spree of robbery, kidnapping and murder, and then disappeared. By the time they were identified, they already had a twelve-hour lead. As the hunt for the two men expanded, the FBI committed its resources to tracking down the suspects. The pursuit would take agents across six states to catch the killers before they struck again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 80's, Florida's cocaine imports were among the highest in the nation. Regional territories were enforced with intimidation and murder. Desperate to stop the violence, local authorities turned to the FBI for help. One dealer bowed to no one. He would stop at nothing to keep detectives and agents from building a case against him. When his organization began targeting the government itself, a city went on high alert.

673500.title: The Caine Mutiny
673500.description: During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.

673500.title: Born Free
673500.description: A British couple in Kenya that raises an orphaned lion cub to adulthood train her to live in the wild when a warden demands she be sent to a zoo.

673500.title: Jeanne Eagels
673500.description: A look into the life of the celebrated Broadway actress who in 1922 made her name playing Sadie Thompson in Somerset Maugham's "Rain."

673500.title: The Jolson Story
673500.description: At the turn of the 20th century, young Asa Yoelson (Scotty Beckett) decides to go against the wishes of his cantor father (Ludwig Donath) and pursue a career in show business. Gradually working his way up through the vaudeville ranks, Asa -- now calling himself Al Jolson (Larry Parks) -- joins a blackface minstrel troupe and soon builds a reputation as a consummate performer. But as his career grows in size, so does his ego, resulting in battles in business as well as in his personal life.

673500.title: Human Desire
673500.description: Returning from the Korean War, a railroad engineer gets mixed up with a coworker's wife who is sick of her husband's violent, jealous ways.

673500.title: Pal Joey
673500.description: Charming musical featuring the love triangle between a lovable but mischievous man and the two women who could change his life, for love or money.

673500.title: Shockproof
673500.description: Jenny Marsh (Patricia Knight) is a hard-luck dame who's just finished five years in the slammer for killing a man. Jenny's not exactly the murdering type -- she did the deed while defending her jailbird lover, Harry (John Baragrey), which is probably one reason she's attracted the attention of her parole officer, Griff Marat (Cornel Wilde). In fact, Griff is so taken with Jenny that he gets her a job caring for his ailing mother, but although Jenny tries to fly right, she's not yet over Harry.

sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Join PBS News Hour's Nick Schifrin and leading experts as they analyse prominent international affairs topics and their impact on America today. (News)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord Of The Rings - Journey's End
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Peter Jackson pushes the bounds both on the page and on screen. But will audiences like what they see? A legendary chapter comes to a close leaving its mark on the film industry. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Engineering Tomorrow - Solar Vehicles
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Though electric vehicles are thriving, many still rely on electricity from coal and gas. Engineers are creating emission-free cars and boats powered directly by the sun. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Eurovision Song Contest Asia
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: From national selection shows across Asia to a live Grand Final, Eurovision Song Contest Asia makes its debut in 2026, with Bangkok hosting the inaugural edition. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Fleishman Is In Trouble - This Is My Enjoyment
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Toby tries to move on. Karen Cooper's case comes to a head. Toby, Seth and Libby attend a reunion party. Libby reflects on her past. (Drama)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner - Unbreakable Codes
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: For centuries, mankind has created unbreakable codes to conceal valuable information. If these codes can be deciphered, could we unlock answers to some of history's greatest mysteries? (Special Interest)

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Long Live Robin Hood
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: This Italian-made retelling of the Robin Hood legend follows Sir Henry of Nottingham as he returns from the Crusades to lead a revolt against Prince John's tyrannical rule.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: U-96, The True Story Of Das Boot
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: The success of the film Das Boot made the U-96. Its fictionally recounts the 7th combat patrol at sea, the most famous of all Hitler's submarines and one of the most famous movie submarines.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Eagle Huntress
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: This spell-binding documentary follows Aisholpan, a 13-year-old nomadic Mongolian girl who is fighting to become the first female eagle hunter in twelve generations of her Kazakh family.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Finding Altamira
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: In 1879, a Spanish archaeologist and his daughter cause worldwide controversy when they discover cave paintings that are 10,000 years old. (Antonio Banderas, Golshifteh Farahani).

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Home Song Stories
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Rose (Joan Chen) is a Hong Kong nightclub singer who emigrates to Australia with her husband, Bill and her two children. The couple's relationship doesn't last long, but they attempt to reconcile.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Queen Of My Dreams
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Connected through a shared love of Bollywood, a distant mother and daughter come of age in two different eras.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Doug and Abi are taking their three children on a trip to Scotland for a big family gathering. They are in the midst of a difficult divorce, and have asked the kids to keep it a secret from their extended family.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Marie's Story
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Marie Heurtin is born both blind and deaf. Sister Marguerette wins her trust and teaches her how to express herself.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Spitfire
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Exploring the history of the Spitfire airplane in commemoration of the Royal Air Force's centenary. Directed by David Fairhead and Ant Palmer, starring John Ackroyd, Charles Dance, Mary Ellis.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Sisu
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: A gold prospector goes to extreme lengths to protect his treasure from a brutal Nazi death squad.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Flowers Of War
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: A Westerner finds refuge with a group of women in a church during Japan's rape of Nanking in 1937. Posing as a priest, he attempts to lead the women to safety.
